10k.note: Formerly Entero Therapeutics (ENTO); rebranded to GridAI Technologies Corp. on 2025-12-01 after acquiring Grid AI Corp. (energy orchestration software). Now primarily an AI/energy company with one retained legacy biotech asset (Adrulipase).

website.note: Corporate site is now an energy AI platform site; biotech program is dormant.

ctgov.note: Per 10-K (filed 2026-05-01): 'As of December 31, 2025, no active clinical trials of Adrulipase were being conducted.'

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Company has rebranded to AI/energy orchestration (GridAI / AMPX platform) following the September 2025 acquisition of Grid AI Corp. The only retained legacy biopharmaceutical asset is Adrulipase (recombinant non-animal lipase for cystic fibrosis EPI and chronic pancreatitis); per the FY2025 10-K, no clinical trials of Adrulipase were conducted during 2025 and any future advancement is contingent on capital and strategic priorities. Discontinued/divested legacy programs include Latiglutenase, CypCel (rescinded with ImmunogenX 2025-12-31), Capeserod (Sanofi license terminated 2025), and Niclosamide.

excluded_legacy_terminated.indication: EPI in cystic fibrosis (monotherapy + combo with PERT)
excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: All Phase 2 trials concluded by 2023; OPTION 2 missed primary endpoint; no active trials in 2025; future development contingent on funding
Phase 2 met endpoint 2018; no further development active
Rescinded back to former ImmunogenX shareholders 2025-12-31
